# Statistical modelling
```{r}
# Gene expression
dge_btm_process_genes_diff_bygene = readRDS(here("tables", "human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_all_immune_nonimmune.rds"))
dge_btm_process_genes_diff_bygene_clean = dge_btm_process_genes_diff_bygene %>% 
  filter(gene_set == "All genes", comparison == "Human vs. Mouse") %>% 
  filter(pathogen_mouse != "DMD") %>% 
  select(treatment = treatment_human, pathogen = pathogen_human, timepoint_comparison, hgnc_symbol = human_symbol, 
         mean_log2fc_diff, se_mouse) %>% 
  mutate(inverse_se_mouse = 1/se_mouse,
         abs_log2fc_diff = abs(mean_log2fc_diff)) %>% 
  select(-se_mouse, -mean_log2fc_diff)
  

#LEGs
all_human_mouse_gsea_btm_results_core_joined = readRDS(file = here("tables", "all_human_mouse_gsea_btm_results_core_joined.rds"))
gsea_btm_legs_clean =
  all_human_mouse_gsea_btm_results_core_joined %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  select(pathogen, timepoint_comparison, hgnc_symbol = gene, status) %>% 
  distinct()

#Merge gene expression with LEGs classification
gsea_btm_legs_dge_stats = gsea_btm_legs_clean %>% 
  full_join(dge_btm_process_genes_diff_bygene_clean,
            by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint_comparison, hgnc_symbol)) %>% 
  mutate(status = if_else(is.na(status), "Not LEG", status))

#Filter timepoints
dge_btm_process_genes_diff_bygene_clean_filtered = 
  dge_btm_process_genes_diff_bygene_clean %>% 
  inner_join(
    gsea_btm_legs_clean %>%
      select(pathogen, timepoint_comparison) %>% distinct(),
    by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint_comparison)
  )


#Protein identity
alignments_human2mouse_all = readRDS(file = here("tables", "alignments_human2mouse_all.rds"))

#Distance
human_mouse_cds_distance = readRDS(file = here::here("tables", "human_mouse_cds_distance.rds"))

#Transcription factors
gene_tf_shared_unique = readRDS(file = here("tables", "gene_tf_shared_unique.rds"))

#BTMs annotation
btm_annotation_genes <- read_csv(here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv")) %>% 
  select(hgnc_symbol = symbol, process, group, subgroup) %>% 
  distinct()

btm_annotation_genes_wide = btm_annotation_genes %>% 
  select(hgnc_symbol, group) %>% 
  group_by(hgnc_symbol, group) %>% 
  summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = group,
              values_from = n) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("hgnc_symbol") %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("hgnc_symbol")

```


```{r}
# #CREs for LEGs and not-LEGS, with gene expression stats and protein AA identity%
# cres_type_homology_comparison_dge_legs_stats = readRDS(file = here("tables", "cres_type_homology_comparison_dge_legs_stats.rds"))
# #CREs (all genes)
cres_type_homology_comparison = readRDS(file = here("tables", "cres_type_homology_comparison.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(type_mouse = if_else(is.na(type_mouse), "Unknown", type_mouse),
         subtype_mouse = if_else(is.na(subtype_mouse), "Unknown", subtype_mouse),
         match_cretype = if_else(is.na(match_cretype), "Unknown", match_cretype),
         match_cresubtype = if_else(is.na(match_cresubtype), "Unknown", match_cresubtype),) %>% 
  group_by(hgnc_symbol, type_human) %>% 
  mutate(n_cat = if_else(n_cat == 0, NA, n_cat)) %>% 
  fill(n_cat, .direction = "downup")

cres_type_homology_comparison_clean = cres_type_homology_comparison %>% 
  select(hgnc_symbol, type_human, subtype_human, match_cretype, match_cresubtype,
         # n_cat, 
         n_total_cre_type_human, n_total_cre_subtype_human, pct_same_cre_type, pct_same_cre_subtype, 
         # match_homology_group, pct_homology
         ) %>% 
  distinct()

#Pivot wider
cres_type_homology_comparison_clean_wide = 
  cres_type_homology_comparison_clean %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = c(hgnc_symbol),
    names_from  = c(type_human, subtype_human, match_cretype, match_cresubtype),
    values_from = c(n_total_cre_type_human, n_total_cre_subtype_human, pct_same_cre_type, pct_same_cre_subtype),
    names_sep   = "_"
  ) %>%  
  column_to_rownames("hgnc_symbol") %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
   #Fill post-pivot NAs with 0 for numeric features
  replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("hgnc_symbol")

```


```{r}
#Merge features
human_mouse_parameters_values = 
  #Annotate with CDS distance (Kimura)
  human_mouse_cds_distance %>% select(hgnc_symbol, dist_k80) %>% 
  #Annotate with AA identity %
  inner_join(alignments_human2mouse_all,
             by = join_by("hgnc_symbol" == "gene")) %>% 
  #Annotate with BTMs 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes_wide,
             by = "hgnc_symbol") %>% 
  #Annotate with TFs
  inner_join(gene_tf_shared_unique,
             by = join_by("hgnc_symbol" == "gene")) %>% 
  #Annotate with CRES
  inner_join(cres_type_homology_comparison_clean_wide,
             by = join_by(hgnc_symbol)) %>% 
  #Annotate with gene expression
  inner_join(dge_btm_process_genes_diff_bygene_clean_filtered,
             by = join_by(hgnc_symbol)) %>% 
  #Annotate with LEG classification
  left_join(gsea_btm_legs_clean, 
             by = join_by(hgnc_symbol, pathogen, timepoint_comparison)) 

#Save
human_mouse_parameters_values %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "human_mouse_statsmodelling_parameters_values.rds"))



human_mouse_parameters_values_regression = human_mouse_parameters_values %>% 
  select(-status) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(treatment:abs_log2fc_diff,inverse_se_mouse, hgnc_symbol, everything())

human_mouse_parameters_values_classification_legs = human_mouse_parameters_values %>% 
  drop_na(status) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
  status_bin = factor(dplyr::if_else(status == "Shared", "Shared", "Not_Shared"), levels = c("Not_Shared", "Shared"))
  ) %>% 
  select(treatment:inverse_se_mouse, inverse_se_mouse, hgnc_symbol, status_bin, everything()) %>% 
  select(!c(status, abs_log2fc_diff)) 

human_mouse_parameters_values
```

```{r}
# Create a feature dictionary
#BTMs
btm_feature_names = btm_annotation_genes_wide %>%
  colnames() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(feature_type = "BTMs") %>% 
  rename(feature_name = ".") %>% 
  filter(feature_name != "hgnc_symbol")

#CREs
cre_feature_names <- cres_type_homology_comparison_clean_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(-hgnc_symbol) %>%
  colnames()

annotated_cre_variables_df <- tibble::tibble(feature_name_original = cre_feature_names) %>%
  tidyr::extract(
    col     = feature_name_original,
    into    = c("variable", "type_human", "subtype_human", "match_cretype", "match_cresubtype"),
    regex   = "^(n_total_cre_type_human|n_total_cre_subtype_human|pct_same_cre_type|pct_same_cre_subtype)_(PLS|pELS|dELS)_(CTCF|not-CTCF)_(Same|Different|Unknown)_(Same|Different|Unknown)$",
    remove  = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Simplify raw metric prefixes into short readable labels
    variable_clean = dplyr::case_when(
      variable == "pct_same_cre_type"        ~ "%Same Type",
      variable == "pct_same_cre_subtype"     ~ "%Same Subtype",
      variable == "n_total_cre_type_human"   ~ "nTotal CRE type",
      variable == "n_total_cre_subtype_human" ~ "nTotal CRE subtype",
      TRUE                                   ~ variable
    ),
    # Construct feature category and cleaned feature name
    feature_type = stringr::str_c("CREs | ", type_human, ", ", subtype_human),
    feature_name = stringr::str_c(
      "Type: ", match_cretype, 
      ", Subtype: ", match_cresubtype, 
      " (", variable_clean, ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(type_human, subtype_human, match_cretype, match_cresubtype) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    feature_name = forcats::fct_inorder(feature_name)
  )



#Feature dictionary
feature_dictionary =  
  human_mouse_parameters_values %>% 
  names() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rename(feature_name_original = ".") %>% 
  mutate(feature_type = case_when(feature_name_original %in% c("inverse_se_mouse") ~ "Gene expression",
                                  feature_name_original %in% c("dist_k80", "identity_human2mouse") ~ "Sequence evolution",
                                  feature_name_original %in% c("n_tf_unique", "pct_tf_unique", "n_tf_shared", "pct_tf_shared") ~ "Transcription Factor",
                                  T ~ NA),
         feature_name = case_when(feature_name_original %in% c("inverse_se_mouse") ~ "1/SE",
                                  feature_name_original %in% c("identity_human2mouse") ~ "%Protein AA identity",
                                  feature_name_original %in% c("dist_k80") ~ "Kimura distance",
                                  feature_name_original %in% c("n_tf_unique") ~ "nUnique",
                                  feature_name_original %in% c("pct_tf_unique") ~ "%Unique",
                                  feature_name_original %in% c("n_tf_shared") ~ "nShared",
                                  feature_name_original %in% c("pct_tf_shared") ~ "%Shared",
                                  T ~ feature_name_original)) %>% 
  drop_na(feature_type) %>% 
  bind_rows(
    #BTMs
    btm_feature_names %>% mutate(feature_name_original = feature_name),
    #CREs
    annotated_cre_variables_df %>% 
              select(feature_name, feature_name_original, feature_type)) %>% 
  mutate(feature_type = fct_relevel(feature_type, "Gene expression", "Sequence evolution", "Transcription Factor", 
                                    "BTMs",
                                    "CREs | PLS, CTCF", "CREs | PLS, not-CTCF",
                                    "CREs | pELS, CTCF", "CREs | pELS, not-CTCF",
                                    "CREs | dELS, CTCF", "CREs | dELS, not-CTCF"))

feature_dictionary
```






## Logistic regression (Classify Shared vs Not-Shared LEGs)
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# --------
# Load required core libraries
# --------
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(ranger)
library(pROC)
library(here)

# --------
# Step 1: Define Classification Recipe with Near-Zero Variance Filter
# --------

classification_recipe <- recipes::recipe(status_bin ~ ., data = human_mouse_parameters_values_classification_legs) %>%
  recipes::update_role(hgnc_symbol, treatment, pathogen, timepoint_comparison, new_role = "id") %>%
  recipes::step_dummy(recipes::all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  # Filter near-zero variance predictors to prevent numerical matrix collapse
  recipes::step_nzv(recipes::all_predictors()) %>%
  recipes::step_corr(recipes::all_numeric_predictors(), threshold = 0.9) %>%
  recipes::step_normalize(recipes::all_numeric_predictors())

# --------
# Step 2: Fit Penalized Logistic Regression Model (glmnet)
# --------
# Light Elastic Net penalty (penalty = 0.01) avoids exact 0/1 probability collapse
logistic_spec <- logistic_reg(penalty = 0.01, mixture = 0.5) %>%
  parsnip::set_engine("glmnet") %>%
  parsnip::set_mode("classification")

logistic_workflow <- workflows::workflow() %>%
  workflows::add_recipe(classification_recipe) %>%
  workflows::add_model(logistic_spec)

logistic_fit <- workflows::fit(logistic_workflow, data = human_mouse_parameters_values_classification_legs)

# --------
# Step 3: Extract Tidy Odds Ratios (OR) and Join Dictionary
# --------
logistic_coefficients <- broom::tidy(logistic_fit, penalty = 0.01) %>%
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  dplyr::rename(feature_name_original = term) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    feature_name_original = stringr::str_replace_all(feature_name_original, "`", ""),
    estimate = exp(estimate)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    feature_dictionary,
    by = dplyr::join_by("feature_name_original")
  ) 

# --------
# Step 4: Compute Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC) Safely
# --------
prob_df <- stats::predict(logistic_fit, new_data = human_mouse_parameters_values_classification_legs, type = "prob") %>%
  dplyr::bind_cols(human_mouse_parameters_values_classification_legs %>% dplyr::select(status_bin))

roc_obj_logistic <- pROC::roc(
  response  = prob_df$status_bin,
  predictor = prob_df$.pred_Shared,
  levels    = c("Not_Shared", "Shared")
)

cat("Logistic AUC:", round(pROC::auc(roc_obj_logistic), 3), "\n")
```


```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ==========================================
# APPROACH 2: RANDOM FOREST CLASSIFIER (GINI IMPORTANCE)
# ==========================================

# --------
# Step 2B: Configure Random Forest Classifier (No Tuning/CV)
# --------
# Define Random Forest specification with fixed classification parameters
rf_cls_spec <- rand_forest(
  trees = 1000,
  mtry  = 8,       # Fixed number of predictors sampled at each split
  min_n = 5        # Fixed minimum node size
) %>%
  parsnip::set_engine("ranger", importance = "impurity") %>%
  parsnip::set_mode("classification")

# Assemble workflow with classification recipe
rf_cls_workflow <- workflows::workflow() %>%
  workflows::add_recipe(classification_recipe) %>%
  workflows::add_model(rf_cls_spec)

# --------
# Fit Random Forest Classifier directly on the full classification dataset
# --------
final_rf_cls_fit <- workflows::fit(
  rf_cls_workflow, 
  data = human_mouse_parameters_values_classification_legs
)

# Extract native ranger engine
rf_cls_engine <- workflows::extract_fit_engine(final_rf_cls_fit)

# --------
# Extract Gini Impurity feature importance metric
# --------
rf_cls_importance <- tibble::tibble(
  feature_name_original = names(rf_cls_engine$variable.importance),
  importance            = as.numeric(rf_cls_engine$variable.importance)
) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    feature_dictionary,
    by = dplyr::join_by("feature_name_original")
  )

# --------
# Save model artifacts and importance metrics
# --------
# Save
saveRDS(final_rf_cls_fit, file = here::here("tables", "final_rf_cls_fit.rds"))
saveRDS(rf_cls_importance, file = here::here("tables", "rf_cls_importance.rds"))
```


```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# --------
# Step 5: Filter OR data and render Forest Plot
# --------
p_odds_ratio_forest <- logistic_coefficients %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::aes(
    x     = estimate,
    y     = feature_name %>% fct_rev()
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.6) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(aes(fill = feature_type),
                        size = 2.5, shape = 21, 
                      color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_all$blues) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x     = "Odds Ratio",
    y     = "Feature Predictor",
    fill  = "Feature Category",
    title = paste0("Logistic Regression: Predictors of Shared LEGs (AUC = ", round(pROC::auc(roc_obj_logistic), 3), ")")
  ) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 10), 
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow        = 3,
      byrow       = TRUE,
      title.position = "top"))

print(p_odds_ratio_forest+theme(legend.location = "plot"))


```

## Predict Log2FC Divergence Magnitude
### Linear regression
```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# REGRESSION (Predict Log2FC Divergence Magnitude)
# ==============================================================================

#Recipe
regression_recipe <- recipes::recipe(abs_log2fc_diff ~ ., data = human_mouse_parameters_values_regression) %>%
  recipes::update_role(hgnc_symbol, treatment, pathogen, timepoint_comparison, new_role = "id") %>%
  recipes::step_dummy(recipes::all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  recipes::step_zv(recipes::all_predictors()) %>%
  recipes::step_normalize(recipes::all_numeric_predictors())



# MODEL 1: Linear regression =================
# Configure linear regression specification and recipe
linear_spec <- linear_reg() %>%
  set_engine("lm") %>%
  set_mode("regression")

linear_fit <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(regression_recipe) %>%
  add_model(linear_spec) %>%
  fit(data = human_mouse_parameters_values_regression)

# Extract native LM object for direct diagnostics
linear_lm_engine <- extract_fit_engine(linear_fit)

# Example direct analysis via broom
linear_coefficients <- broom::tidy(linear_lm_engine, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  rename(feature_name_original = term) %>%
  mutate(feature_name_original = str_replace_all(feature_name_original, "`", "")) %>% 
  inner_join(feature_dictionary,
             by = join_by("feature_name_original"))

# Save
saveRDS(linear_lm_engine, file = here::here("tables", "linear_lm_engine.rds"))
saveRDS(linear_coefficients, file = here::here("tables", "linear_lm_engine_coefficients.rds"))


# MODEL 2: RANDOM FOREST  ==================
# Define Random Forest specification with fixed hyperparameters (no tuning grid)
rf_spec <- rand_forest(
  trees = 1000,
  mtry  = 8,       # Fixed number of predictors sampled at each split
  min_n = 5        # Fixed minimum node size
) %>%
  set_engine("ranger", importance = "impurity") %>%
  set_mode("regression")

# Assemble workflow
rf_workflow <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(regression_recipe) %>%
  add_model(rf_spec)

# Fit Random Forest 
final_rf_fit <- fit(rf_workflow, data = human_mouse_parameters_values)

# Extract native ranger engine
rf_engine <- extract_fit_engine(final_rf_fit)

# Extract Gini Impurity feature importance metric
rf_importance <- tibble(
  feature_name_original = names(rf_engine$variable.importance),
  importance            = as.numeric(rf_engine$variable.importance)
) %>%
  inner_join(
    feature_dictionary,
    by = join_by("feature_name_original")
  )

# Save
saveRDS(final_rf_fit, file = here::here("tables", "final_rf_fit.rds"))
saveRDS(rf_importance, file = here::here("tables", "rf_importance.rds"))
```



```{r fig.height=20, fig.width=12}
# ==========================================
# EVALUATION & MODEL COMPARISON
# ==========================================

# --------
# Step 3: Compute Out-of-Sample Predictions and Metrics
# --------
# Generate predictions for GLM Gamma and Random Forest
eval_table <- human_mouse_parameters_values_regression %>%
  select(abs_log2fc_diff) %>%
  bind_cols(
    predict(final_rf_fit, new_data = human_mouse_parameters_values_regression) %>% rename(pred_rf = .pred),
    predict(linear_fit, new_data = human_mouse_parameters_values_regression) %>% rename(pred_linear = .pred)
  )

# Performance Metrics: lm
metrics_lm <- metric_set(rmse, rsq)(eval_table, truth = abs_log2fc_diff, estimate = pred_linear) %>%
  mutate(model = "Linear")

# Performance Metrics: Random Forest
metrics_rf <- metric_set(rmse, rsq)(eval_table, truth = abs_log2fc_diff, estimate = pred_rf) %>%
  mutate(model = "Random Forest")

model_comparison_metrics <- bind_rows(metrics_lm, metrics_rf)
print(model_comparison_metrics)

name_order = rf_importance %>%
  arrange(importance) %>% 
  mutate(feature_name = fct_inorder(feature_name))

### Assess
linear_coefficients_forest_plot = linear_coefficients %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    feature_name = factor(feature_name, levels = levels(name_order$feature_name))
  ) %>%
  ggplot() +
  aes(
    x    = estimate,
    y    = feature_name,
    xmin = conf.low,
    xmax = conf.high
  ) +
  facet_grid(feature_type~., space = "free",
             scales = "free_y") +
  # Reference line at zero effect
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.6) +
  # Confidence intervals (horizontal error bars)
  geom_errorbarh(height = 0.2, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(color = p.value <= 0.05), size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "#4DBBD5FF", "FALSE" = "gray60"),
    labels = c("TRUE" = "p <= 0.05", "FALSE" = "p > 0.05")
  ) +
  labs(
    x     = expression("Standardized Effect Size (" * beta * ")"),
    y     = "Predictor Variable",
    color = "Significance",
    title = "Linear Regression: Predictors of |ΔLog2FC|"
  ) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 9),
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5)
  )

linear_coefficients_forest_plot
```

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=3}
      y = predicted, 
      color = model) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15, size = 1, color = "black") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = T, size = 1, color = "#4DBBD5FF") +
  facet_wrap(~ model, nrow = 2, axes = "all") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_obs_pred() +
  labs(
    x     = expression("Observed Divergence (" * "|" * Delta * "Log"[2] * "FC|" * ")"),
    y     = expression("Predicted Divergence (" * hat(Y) * ")")
  ) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title.position = "plot")

print(p_obs_vs_pred)
```
